name: screenshot.capture
description: Capture a headless browser screenshot (PNG) of a URL, local HTML file, or the running dev frontend ('dev') and return the saved PNG path. The image already renders inline in chat; do not call image.view afterward or display the same image again. Use this to visually show the user UI state, designs, or layout issues.

target.description: URL (http/https), the literal 'dev' (the frontend dev server), or a local HTML file path.

path.description: Optional output PNG path. Defaults to .jait/shots/screenshot-<timestamp>.png

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page (default true)

selector.description: Crop to the first element matching this CSS selector

waitMs.description: Extra settle delay in ms after load (default 500)

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for (visible) before capturing

items.description: CSS selector to click before capturing

click.description: Click these elements before capturing (in order).

fill.description: Fill inputs before capturing. Each item is 'cssSelector:text'.
